chosen: 2026-10-30: the 2026-10-29 list re-run unchanged to measure the changes since (targeted tests, cached base failures, polish caps, time limit, verify alongside reconcile, playbooks, issue screenshots), committed before any run
criteria: Open GitHub issues in popular pure-Python repos with pytest suites, filed 2026-08-01 or later, with no linked pull request, that report a reproducible bug in library code still present in the current code. Excluded: feature requests, docs, refactors, CI, typing-only, performance, spam, and issues a commenter or maintainer shows are already fixed or intended. Whether someone offered to fix it doesn't matter: no pull request is opened.

excluded.why: closed upstream after the first run; its fix may be in the code now
